name: shipgraph-monorepo
description: shipgraph — framework-agnostic, MIT graph visualization component. Monorepo root.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @shipgraph/core && npm run build -w @shipgraph/vue && npm run build -w @shipgraph/react && npm run build -w @shipgraph/svelte && npm run docs:build
scripts.test: npm run test -w @shipgraph/core && npm run test -w @shipgraph/vue && npm run test -w @shipgraph/react && npm run test -w @shipgraph/svelte
